mapper.select: SELECT O.OFC_CODE, O.KANM, RTRIM(O.JUNG_MOJUM) AS REGION_CODE FROM TB_OFC_RAW R JOIN TB_OFC_REG_MGT O ON O.OFC_CODE = CAST(R.ONLINE_CODE AS CHAR(6)) WHERE R.SAMUSO = #{samuso} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT O.OFC_CODE, O.KANM, RTRIM(O.JUNG_MOJUM) AS REGION_CODE FROM TB_OFC_REG_MGT O WHERE O.OFC_CODE = CAST(#{ofcCode} AS CHAR(6))

SELECT P.OFC_CODE, P.KANM, NULL AS REGION_CODE FROM TB_OFC_REG_MGT P WHERE P.OFC_CODE IN (SELECT CAST(M.JUNG_MOJUM AS CHAR(6)) FROM TB_OFC_REG_MGT M WHERE M.JUNG_MOJUM IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY P.OFC_CODE
SELECT O.OFC_CODE, O.KANM, RTRIM(O.JUNG_MOJUM) AS REGION_CODE FROM TB_OFC_REG_MGT O WHERE O.JUNG_MOJUM = #{region} ORDER BY O.OFC_CODE

choose.when: AND (M.OFC_CODE = CAST(#{ofcCode} AS CHAR(6)) OR NVL(P.BLT_OLD_OFC_CODE, M.OFC_CODE) = CAST(#{ofcCode} AS CHAR(6)))

AND (M.OFC_CODE IN (SELECT G.OFC_CODE FROM TB_OFC_REG_MGT G WHERE G.JUNG_MOJUM = #{region} OR G.OFC_CODE = CAST(#{region} AS CHAR(6))) OR NVL(P.BLT_OLD_OFC_CODE, M.OFC_CODE) IN (SELECT G.OFC_CODE FROM TB_OFC_REG_MGT G WHERE G.JUNG_MOJUM = #{region} OR G.OFC_CODE = CAST(#{region} AS CHAR(6))))

mapper.sql: FROM TB_MCN_INFO M JOIN TB_SCRT_INST_PST P ON P.OFC_CODE = M.OFC_CODE AND P.INST_PST_CODE = RTRIM(M.INST_PST_CODE) AND P.USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.select:
SELECT M.OFC_CODE AS MGR_OFC_CODE, O1.KANM AS MGR_OFC_NM, NVL(P.BLT_OLD_OFC_CODE, M.OFC_CODE) AS PARENT_OFC_CODE, O2.KANM AS PARENT_OFC_NM, P.INST_PST_NM, M.MCN_NO, NVL(S.SRC_NM, M.SRC) AS SRC_NM,
NVL(C.CODE_NM, M.VEND_CODE) AS VEND_NM,
M.VEND_CODE AS VEND_NM,
M.KOM_TYPE AS MODEL_NM, NVL(O2.ADDRESS, O1.ADDRESS) AS ADDRESS, CASE WHEN P.IAL_SEV_VEND_OP_YN = 'Y' AND P.IAL_SEV_VEND_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN P.IAL_SEV_VEND_CODE ELSE P.VEND_CODE END AS MGMT_VEND_CODE, T.POWER_OFF, T.USE_STOP, T.ERR_MODE, (SELECT MAX(H.ERR_NM) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY H.ERR_OCR_DT, H.ERR_OCR_TIME) FROM TB_EE_MCN_ERR_HIST H WHERE H.OFC_CODE = M.OFC_CODE AND H.MCN_NO = M.MCN_NO) AS STATUS_DETAIL
LEFT JOIN TB_OFC_REG_MGT O1 ON O1.OFC_CODE = M.OFC_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_OFC_REG_MGT O2 ON O2.OFC_CODE = NVL(P.BLT_OLD_OFC_CODE, M.OFC_CODE) LEFT JOIN TB_NMS_SRC S ON S.SRC = M.SRC
LEFT JOIN TB_CODE_DTL C ON C.CODE_SECT = #{vendorCodeType} AND C.CODE = M.VEND_CODE
LEFT JOIN TB_OP_ATM_STAT T ON T.OFC_CODE = M.OFC_CODE AND T.MCN_NO = M.MCN_NO WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY M.OFC_CODE, M.MCN_NO

SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(D.CASH_PMT_CNT, 0) + NVL(D.CHK_PMT_CNT, 0) + NVL(D.CASH_DEPO_CNT, 0) + NVL(D.CHK_DEPO_CNT, 0)), 0) FROM TB_OP_DEAL_OFCSUM D JOIN TB_MCN_INFO M ON M.OFC_CODE = D.OFC_CODE AND M.MCN_NO = D.MCN_NO JOIN TB_SCRT_INST_PST P ON P.OFC_CODE = M.OFC_CODE AND P.INST_PST_CODE = RTRIM(M.INST_PST_CODE) AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE D.DEAL_DT = CAST(#{dealDt} AS CHAR(8)) AND M.USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT HDAY_DT FROM TB_NMS_HDAY WHERE HDAY_DT BETWEEN CAST(#{from} AS CHAR(8)) AND CAST(#{to} AS CHAR(8)) AND HDAY_YN = 'Y'
